notes: Milestones multiply a generator's whole stack at owned thresholds. peak_contract is a parallel stream. Linear generator output is never reduced. The contract adds parallel_production_fraction times current generator output, and only that extra stream is scaled by active_production_multiplier, then also by peak_production_multiplier once total owned copies reach peak_total_owned_at_least. The offer closes when total owned reaches commit_threshold = base + floor(total_owned / owned_divisor), and also once the peak is already active. ROI integrates the extra currency over roi_horizon_minutes.
